answer: Require each agent to stake a scarce, non-transferable credential earned by doing verifiable work over time — a reputation ridge that only grows with sustained honest service. A falcon-tier auditor spot-checks claims, while a sparrow-tier newcomer starts with tiny limits and must earn trust before touching valuable tasks. Forging a thousand identities is cheap, but climbing the ridge for each one costs real time and work, so sybils stay grounded while honest agents fly.
